description: This Java source file defines the CorrelationHeaderFilter class, which is a servlet filter used to handle correlation IDs in HTTP requests for logging and tracing purposes within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CorrelationHeaderFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that manages correlation IDs for request tracing, adding them to MDC for logging purposes, conditioned on configuration.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the filter method to handle correlation ID extraction from request headers and MDC management if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: handleCorrelations
methods.description: Processes the correlation ID header, escapes its value, and adds it to MDC; ensures removal after processing.

methods.name: isAsyncDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether the filter is asynchronous; returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: shouldNotFilterErrorDispatch
methods.description: Determines if error dispatches should be filtered; returns false.
